title: Live Figure Deck
user: Scientists and educators who need a few formula-driven, animated explanatory figures in a talk without adopting a full animation pipeline.
smallest_useful_product: A static web editor with formula labels, a 2D plot, parameter sliders, named animation intervals, and export to a self-contained HTML slide or MP4-ready frame sequence.
constraints: Math rendering must work offline; label animation intervals precisely; export must be deterministic; do not imply mathematical correctness beyond user-entered equations.
